label: Small Biotech IND — CSR Synopsis
description: Clinical Study Report synopsis for NovaTide-1 Phase 1 dose-escalation study (LTX-001).

inputs.study_title: A Phase 1, Open-Label, Dose-Escalation and Expansion Study of NovaTide-1 in Patients with Relapsed/Refractory Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
inputs.primary_objective: To determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of NovaTide-1
inputs.secondary_objective: To evaluate preliminary anti-tumor activity (ORR per Lugano 2014), pharmacokinetics, and immunogenicity
inputs.study_design: Open-label, multicenter, 3+3 dose escalation followed by dose expansion
inputs.study_duration: Screening through 6-month follow-up post last dose
inputs.study_population: Adults ≥18 years with R/R DLBCL after ≥2 prior systemic therapies
inputs.dosage_regimen: NovaTide-1 0.1–10 mg/kg IV weekly × 8 then q2w (step-up dosing in Cycle 1 at RP2D)
inputs.study_conclusions: NovaTide-1 has an acceptable safety profile at the recommended Phase 2 dose of 3 mg/kg with step-up dosing. The preliminary ORR of 52% in heavily pretreated R/R DLBCL patients supports further clinical development. A Phase 2 study is planned.
